top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks (Katori, Ye) rest on one concrete idea, the magic-wavelength trap, and a 10^-18 realization reproduced independently in several laboratories with different atoms, which is the robustness I require. The two-name allocation is uncontested in the record, and a citation on the invention and realization does not depend on the pending redefinition of the second. I would still weigh a new phase of matter higher in the abstract, but no award is a worse outcome than a mature, reproducible, well-attributed achievement.
